verdict.rationale: Rippling documents specific bulk actions (bulk EOI/dependent approval and coverage updates, bulk payroll adjustments) showing some cross-item automation, but these are narrow HR/benefits use cases rather than a general AI-native 'bulk operate across many items' capability spanning employees, apps, or other object types. The CSV-driven payroll incident affecting 20k employees also shows bulk processing exists but highlights fragility rather than confidence in bulk operations. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose bulk edit/actions across arbitrary object types (not just benefits/payroll), explicit AI-agent-triggered bulk operations, and independent hands-on confirmation of reliability at scale.
